overview.description: The MicroSectors Oil & Gas Exp. & Prod. - 3x Inverse Leveraged ETN (OILD) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in energy equity. The fund provides 300% daily inverse exposure to a liquidity-weighted index of US firms involved in oil and gas exploration and production. OILD was launched on Nov 8, 2021 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
